## Infinity Natural Resources Announces Corporate Reorganization to Simplify Its Up-C Structure


November 18, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/940357400/files/doc_news/2026/11/18/INR-Reorg-Press-Release.pdf)


MORGANTOWN, W.Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Infinity Natural Resources, Inc. (“Infinity” or the “Company”) (NYSE: INR) today announced a corporate reorganization that will simplify its Up-C structure, with participation from Infinity’s pre-IPO owners, including Pearl Energy, NGP Capital Management and certain members of management and the board of directors.


“Our planned conversion from an Up-C to a traditional C-Corporation will simplify our ownership structure, reduce administrative burden and overhead expenses, further align our legacy owners with our public stockholders and significantly reduce future Tax Receivable Agreement (TRA) obligations. We believe the conversion will improve transparency, broaden institutional investor appeal and enhance strategic flexibility without impacting our existing operations and strategy,” said Zack Arnold, President and CEO of Infinity.


**Details of Transaction**


The reorganization will not result in any changes for the Company’s public stockholders, and the total number of shares outstanding will remain the same. Furthermore, the overall proportionate economic ownership and voting percentage of equity holders in our business after the completion of the reorganization will be the same as their current overall proportionate economic ownership and voting percentage in our business immediately prior to completion of the reorganization. The reorganization does not constitute a change of control under any of our debt agreements or the Series A preferred stock.


The Company’s Board of Directors, following the recommendation of a Special Committee thereof (formed for purposes of evaluating the reorganization), approved the reorganization, pursuant to which, among other things, (a) all holders of limited liability company interests (“LLC Units”) in Infinity Natural Resources, LLC (“INR LLC”) will (i) contribute their LLC Units to a new public holding company (“New PubCo”) and surrender and transfer their shares of Class B common stock to the Company for retirement in exchange for newly issued shares of New PubCo’s Class A common stock and (ii) waive their TRA rights, and (b) the Company (“Old PubCo”) will reorganize under New PubCo, whereby the Company will become a wholly owned subsidiary of New PubCo, and New PubCo will adopt the name “Infinity Natural Resources, Inc.” and replace Old PubCo as the public company trading on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the ticker symbol “INR.” Old PubCo will be renamed “Infinity Natural Resources Holdings, Inc.” With the holders waiving their TRA rights, the Company will retain 100% of the benefit of the step up in tax basis resulting from the reorganization, and future obligations under the TRA will be significantly reduced.


Following these changes, the number of shares of Class A common stock of New PubCo outstanding will consist of the aggregate number of shares of Class A common stock and Class B common stock of the Company that are outstanding immediately prior to the reorganization. The reorganization is expected to close on December 1, 2026, and New PubCo’s Class A common stock will begin trading on the NYSE on December 2, 2026. **About Infinity**


Infinity (NYSE: INR) is a growth oriented, independent energy company focused on the acquisition, development, production and gathering of hydrocarbons in the Appalachian Basin. Our operations are focused on the Utica Shale in eastern Ohio and the Marcellus and Utica Shales in southwestern Pennsylvania.
